concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-articles-aib-af-change-your-bank-account]] - 2026-09-16 Braintree-hosted AIB AF route for changing the business checking account used for settled-transaction payouts through a Control Panel upload of a qualifying bank statement or signed bank letter, with document-recency and account-type exclusions; not AIB BF, current independent bank authority, completed-change or payout proof, or evidence for the presence or absence of an API route
warnings: Keep this reciprocal route scoped to the captured AIB AF article; do not transfer its document or account conditions to AIB BF or another processor, account, region, or pricing configuration.
The documented Control Panel procedure neither proves nor disproves that an API route exists, and linked pages are navigation rather than evidence of target agreement.
The snapshot is not independent current bank policy or proof that a requested change, settlement, payout, or deposit completed.
